ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Child Care Program Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota's child care programs and potential connections to similar issues in other states.
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota's child care programs?
Are there connections to similar issues in other states?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of fraud in child care programs across the country, potentially leading to significant reforms and recoveries.
